scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle.
The driver making a PASS.
A person driving a motor vehicle on the road.
A person riding a bicycle.

A designated area where pedestrians may cross a road with no traffic lights, identified by specific signs, overhead yellow lights and two white double parallel lines across the road with an X in each approaching lane.
The part of a roadway that connects sidewalks on opposite sides into a continuous path, or that has signs, lines or other markings for pedestrian crossing; it may be unmarked.
A continuous painted line on the road.
A dashed painted line on the road.
A rail vehicle running on tracks in the roadway that stops to let passengers on and off.
A large commercial vehicle such as a tractor-trailer, truck or bus.
A double-trailer commercial vehicle up to 40 metres long, identified by a rear LCV placard.
An orange triangle with a red border on the rear of a vehicle, showing it will travel at 40 km/h or less.
A cart, buggy or wagon pulled by a horse, one of the slowest road users.
A snow-removal vehicle operating on a public road.
A police, fire, ambulance or special public-utility vehicle identified by flashing red or blue lights, a siren or bell, or alternating flashes of white light from its high beams.
A centre lane used by left-turning vehicles from both directions to wait for a chance to turn.
A special passing or climbing lane that lets slower vehicles move into the right-hand lane so faster ones can pass in the left lane.
A high-speed, multi-lane road where traffic in each direction is separated and ramps let vehicles enter and exit.
On a high-speed road with three or more lanes each way where trucks may not use the far left lane, the lane next to the far left lane.
The area on each side of the vehicle that the driver cannot see.
A chrome-yellow bus that displays the words 'School Bus'.
A physical barrier, such as a raised, lowered, earth or paved strip, built to separate traffic travelling in different directions, which vehicles cannot cross.

rules.title: Pass only without danger
rules.when: considering whether to overtake and pass another vehicle
rules.action: begin the PASS
rules.unless: the DRIVER is sure the PASS can be made without danger to the DRIVER or others
rules.statement: WHEN considering whether to overtake and pass another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT begin the PASS, UNLESS the DRIVER is sure the PASS can be made without danger to the DRIVER or others.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria for certainty given
no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: If in doubt, do not pass
rules.when: the DRIVER is in doubt about whether a PASS can be made safely
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in doubt about whether a PASS can be made safely, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass.

vague_terms.explanation: degree of uncertainty not defined
no criterion for a safe pass given

rules.note: The handbook says only 'If in doubt, do not pass'; the object of the doubt (whether the pass can be made without danger) is taken from the preceding sentence in 10.15.

rules.title: Enough space and time
rules.when: about to begin a PASS
rules.action: be sure there is enough space and time to complete the PASS safely
rules.statement: WHEN about to begin a PASS, the PASSER MUST be sure there is enough space and time to complete the PASS safely.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time given
no criteria given

rules.title: Keep right except to pass
rules.when: driving on a road
rules.action: keep to the right of the road, or in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane road
rules.unless: preparing to turn left OR passing another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a road, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right of the road, or in the right-hand lane on a multi-lane road, UNLESS preparing to turn left OR passing another vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how far before the turn this starts

rules.note: The handbook says this is especially important when driving more slowly than other vehicles. The regulatory 'Slower traffic keep right' sign (18.29) states the slow-traffic case as a requirement: 'Slow traffic on multi-lane roads must keep right.'

rules.title: Freeway left lane for passing only
rules.when: driving on a multi-lane FREEWAY AND passing traffic moving slower than the speed limit
rules.action: use the far left lane, and not stay in that lane after passing
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving a truck on a road that has a TRUCK PASSING LANE
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a multi-lane FREEWAY AND passing traffic moving slower than the speed limit, the DRIVER MUST use the far left lane, and not stay in that lane after passing, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving a truck on a road that has a TRUCK PASSING LANE.

vague_terms.term: not stay in that lane after passing
vague_terms.explanation: no time or distance given for returning to the right after the pass

rules.note: 12.20 words this more softly (traffic should keep to the right, using the left lanes for passing); the stronger plain command of 12.24 is recorded. Trucks barred from the far left lane are covered by PASS-GEN-07. 10.40 also permits passing on the right on multi-lane roads (PASS-SIDE-01); the handbook does not say how the two passages relate.

rules.title: Staying behind is often safer
rules.when: following another vehicle AND considering changing lanes to go around it
rules.action: consider staying behind it for a few seconds rather than going around it
rules.statement: WHEN following another vehicle AND considering changing lanes to go around it, the DRIVER SHOULD consider staying behind it for a few seconds rather than going around it.

vague_terms.explanation: no duration given

rules.note: The handbook says spending a few seconds behind another vehicle is often safer than going around it.

rules.title: Trucks keep out of the far left lane
rules.when: on a road that has a TRUCK PASSING LANE
rules.action: use the TRUCK PASSING LANE for passing and not drive in the far left lane
rules.statement: WHEN on a road that has a TRUCK PASSING LANE, the DRIVER of a truck MUST use the TRUCK PASSING LANE for passing and not drive in the far left lane.
rules.note: 10.26 says trucks are not allowed in the far left lane on many high-speed roads with three or more lanes each way; 12.24 says large trucks must use the lane to the right for passing.

rules.title: Signal left and check before pulling out
rules.when: about to change lanes to pass
rules.action: use the left-turn signal, check the mirrors and BLIND SPOT and check that the way is clear ahead and behind
rules.statement: WHEN about to change lanes to pass, the PASSER MUST use the left-turn signal, check the mirrors and BLIND SPOT and check that the way is clear ahead and behind.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or distance given

rules.note: A PASS is a lane change, and the lane-change steps (10.6, 10.7) and 16.40 ('Always check your blind spot: look in your mirror and over your shoulder before you change lanes') give the mirror and blind-spot checks for every lane change; the night-passing steps (10.31) repeat them.

rules.title: Watch for hidden and entering road users
rules.when: preparing to pass a vehicle
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the vehicle being passed, vehicles that may be turning left in front of the PASSER, and vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass a vehicle, the PASSER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles that may be hidden from view in front of the vehicle being passed, vehicles that may be turning left in front of the PASSER, and vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway.

rules.title: Change lanes only after signalling
rules.when: making a PASS
rules.action: change lanes
rules.statement: WHEN making a PASS, the PASSER MUST NOT change lanes, UNLESS the PASSER has signalled.

rules.title: Signal return to lane
rules.when: the PASSER has overtaken the vehicle being passed
rules.action: signal the intention to move back into the lane the PASS started from
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER has overtaken the vehicle being passed, the PASSER MUST signal the intention to move back into the lane the PASS started from.
rules.note: Repeated in the night-passing steps.

rules.title: Return only when front of passed vehicle visible
rules.when: the PASSER has overtaken the vehicle being passed
rules.action: move back into the original lane
rules.unless: the entire front of the passed vehicle can be seen in the inside rear-view mirror
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER has overtaken the vehicle being passed, the PASSER MUST NOT move back into the original lane, UNLESS the entire front of the passed vehicle can be seen in the inside rear-view mirror.
rules.note: Stated in the general passing steps (10.19, 'inside mirror') and repeated in the night passing steps (10.32, 'rear view mirror'). Diagram 2-46 shows the full passing path, pulling out and back in.

rules.title: Do not cut off the passed vehicle
rules.when: moving back in front of the passed vehicle
rules.action: cut off the vehicle by suddenly moving in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN moving back in front of the passed vehicle, the PASSER MUST NOT cut off the vehicle by suddenly moving in front of it.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or timing given

rules.note: 10.19 words this softly ('be careful not to'); the stronger 'Never' of 10.10 (never make sudden lane changes by cutting in front of another vehicle) is recorded. The rule for LARGE VEHICLES is PASS-USER-07.

rules.title: Do not race a vehicle that speeds up
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up
rules.action: go back to the original lane and not race it
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up, the PASSER MUST go back to the original lane and not race it.

rules.title: Low beams when following within 60 metres
rules.when: using headlights AND less than 60 metres behind another vehicle
rules.action: use low-beam headlights
rules.unless: the DRIVER has pulled out and is moving alongside the vehicle being passed
rules.statement: WHEN using headlights AND less than 60 metres behind another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST use low-beam headlights, UNLESS the DRIVER has pulled out and is moving alongside the vehicle being passed.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to lower headlight beam.
rules.note: Stated in 4.65 (with the exception for passing, applying to all roads including divided ones) and in 14.8 (at night, without the exception). The two demerit points are listed for failing to lower headlight beam (22.134, 22.135). 4.65 says 'unless you are passing it'; read, from the night-passing steps (10.30, 10.31), as starting once the DRIVER is alongside. While approaching to pass, low beams are required (PASS-NIGHT-03); high beams come on alongside (PASS-NIGHT-04).

rules.title: Be very careful passing at night
rules.when: passing at night
rules.action: be very careful
rules.statement: WHEN passing at night, the DRIVER SHOULD be very careful.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific behaviour given

rules.title: Low beams on approach at night
rules.when: passing at night AND approaching the vehicle to be passed from behind
rules.action: switch the headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN passing at night AND approaching the vehicle to be passed from behind, the PASSER MUST switch the headlights to low beams.

vague_terms.term: approaching the vehicle to be passed from behind
vague_terms.explanation: no distance given for when to switch to low beams

rules.title: High beams when alongside at night
rules.when: passing at night AND moving alongside the vehicle being passed
rules.action: switch on the high-beam headlights
rules.unless: an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres
rules.statement: WHEN passing at night AND moving alongside the vehicle being passed, the PASSER MUST switch on the high-beam headlights, UNLESS an oncoming vehicle is within 150 metres.
rules.note: Reason given: lets the PASSER see more of the road ahead. The rule to use low beams within 150 metres of an oncoming vehicle (4.65, 14.8) still applies while passing.

rules.title: No passing near a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Stated on two pages and shown on the 'No Passing Here to Crossing' sign at crossovers.

rules.title: No passing left of centreline near bridges and tunnels
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass to the left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass to the left of the centreline.
rules.note: The handbook says 'not permitted 30 metres from a bridge, viaduct or tunnel'; read as 'within 30 metres of', by analogy with the crossover rule in the same block.

rules.title: No passing at hill crests or blind curves
rules.when: there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety AND the view of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND the DRIVER is approaching the crest of a hill or is on a curve
rules.action: attempt to pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety AND the view of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND the DRIVER is approaching the crest of a hill or is on a curve, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass.

vague_terms.explanation: distance not given
no safety margin or criterion given

vague_terms.term: approaching the crest of a hill
vague_terms.explanation: no distance from the crest given

rules.note: 10.22 is ambiguous: the clause 'where your vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed and there is not enough clear distance ahead' may qualify only 'on a curve', in which case passing when approaching a hill crest is barred without further conditions. This rule applies the clause to both situations.

rules.title: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass that vehicle.
rules.note: Reason given: a stopped vehicle may be a clue that a pedestrian is crossing.

rules.title: No passing in a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: on a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing
rules.statement: WHEN on a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing.

rules.title: No passing on the left shoulder
rules.when: passing another vehicle
rules.action: pass on the left shoulder, paved or not
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder, paved or not.

rules.title: Right shoulder only for passing a left-turner
rules.when: passing a vehicle that is turning left AND the right shoulder is paved
rules.action: use the right shoulder to pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN passing a vehicle that is turning left AND the right shoulder is paved, the DRIVER MAY ONLY use the right shoulder to pass that vehicle.
rules.note: MAY ONLY here means driving on the right shoulder is allowed in this situation and in no other; it does not require the DRIVER to use the shoulder.

rules.title: No passing by lane change at intersections
rules.when: in or near an intersection
rules.action: change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN in or near an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT change lanes to pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given

rules.note: Both blocks ban changing lanes in or near an intersection; since a PASS is a lane change, this bans passing there by changing lanes. Passing on the right without a lane change is PASS-SIDE-01. Going around a vehicle that blocks the lane in an intersection is PASS-SIDE-04.

rules.title: Solid line: unsafe to pass
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass.
rules.note: The handbook says the line means it is unsafe to pass and 'A' should not pass; Diagram 3-2 shows vehicles beside solid yellow lines. The handbook gives no exception for moving over a lane to pass roadside workers or vehicles (PASS-USER-22) or a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE or tow truck (PASS-USER-20); both apply only when moving over is safe, and this line marks it as unsafe.

rules.title: Broken line: passing allowed
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough BROKEN LINE remains ahead to complete the PASS safely
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough BROKEN LINE remains ahead to complete the PASS safely, the DRIVER MAY pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

vague_terms.term: enough BROKEN LINE remains ahead to complete the PASS safely
vague_terms.explanation: length of line and safety margin not given

rules.title: Do-not-pass sign
rules.when: on a road posted with a do-not-pass sign
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN on a road posted with a do-not-pass sign, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: Regulatory sign: red circle with a line through two cars.

rules.title: Do not pass a flashing pilot vehicle
rules.when: following a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bearing a do-not-pass 'When Flashing' sign AND the sign is flashing
rules.action: pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN following a pilot vehicle or pace vehicle bearing a do-not-pass 'When Flashing' sign AND the sign is flashing, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass that vehicle.
rules.note: The sign image reads 'WHEN FLASHING'; the caption says do not pass the pilot or pace vehicle bearing it. Worded as a plain command ('Do not pass') in a temporary-condition sign caption.

rules.title: Keep right where a passing lane is provided
rules.when: on a two-lane section where a PASSING LANE is provided AND a keep-right-except-to-pass sign is posted
rules.action: keep to the right lane
rules.statement: WHEN on a two-lane section where a PASSING LANE is provided AND a keep-right-except-to-pass sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right lane, UNLESS the DRIVER is passing.
rules.note: 10.35 describes the same lane use more softly, as the purpose of passing lanes (slower vehicles move into the right-hand lane so faster ones can pass in the left lane); the 'must' of the regulatory sign (18.40) is recorded. Diagram 2-48 shows a truck in the right lane being passed.

rules.title: Merge when passing lane ends
rules.when: in the right-hand lane of a PASSING LANE section AND a sign warns that the lane is ending
rules.action: merge safely with traffic in the left-hand lane
rules.statement: WHEN in the right-hand lane of a PASSING LANE section AND a sign warns that the lane is ending, the DRIVER MUST merge safely with traffic in the left-hand lane.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap given

rules.note: Inferred from two places: 10.36 says an unnamed sign warns that the passing lane is ending so right-lane drivers 'can begin to merge safely' (soft wording); this is taken to be the right-lane-ends sign of 18.70, whose caption says 'you must merge safely with traffic in the lane to the left'. The stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: Hazard marker: pass on the marked side
rules.when: a hazard marker sign is posted at a hazard close to the edge of the road
rules.action: pass the hazard on the side shown by the sign's downward lines
rules.statement: WHEN a hazard marker sign is posted at a hazard close to the edge of the road, the DRIVER MAY pass the hazard on the side shown by the sign's downward lines.
rules.note: The caption says the lines show 'the side on which you may safely pass'; it does not say that passing on the other side is prohibited.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a STREETCAR OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a STREETCAR OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the DRIVER MAY pass on the right.
rules.note: The handbook adds that most passing is done on the left (PASS-SIDE-05, which advises the left even where this rule permits the right) and that passing on the right can be more dangerous. PASS-SIDE-02 and PASS-LOC-07 restrict this permission. Changing lanes to pass in or near an intersection is banned by PASS-LOC-08; going around a vehicle that blocks the lane in an intersection is PASS-SIDE-04. On a multi-lane FREEWAY, 12.24 tells the DRIVER to use the far left lane to pass traffic moving slower than the speed limit (PASS-GEN-05).

rules.title: Wait for a slower vehicle to move right
rules.when: driving in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: wait for the slower vehicle to move to the right and not suddenly change lanes to pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front, the DRIVER MUST wait for the slower vehicle to move to the right and not suddenly change lanes to pass on the right.

vague_terms.explanation: no timing or distance given
no speed difference given
does not say whether to change lanes or shift within the lane, or how far

rules.note: Reason given: the driver in front may move right at the same time.

rules.title: Pass streetcars on the right
rules.when: passing a STREETCAR
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN passing a STREETCAR, the DRIVER MUST pass on the right, UNLESS driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Do not go around a vehicle blocking the lane in an intersection
rules.when: driving through an intersection AND the DRIVER's lane is blocked by a vehicle turning left or a vehicle edging into the intersection from the right
rules.action: slow down or stop and not pull out to go around the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving through an intersection AND the DRIVER's lane is blocked by a vehicle turning left or a vehicle edging into the intersection from the right, the DRIVER MUST slow down or stop and not pull out to go around the vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: no amount or target speed given

rules.title: Pass on the left
rules.when: passing another vehicle
rules.action: pass on the left of the vehicle being passed
rules.unless: passing a STREETCAR AND not driving on a one-way road
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle, the DRIVER SHOULD pass on the left of the vehicle being passed, UNLESS passing a STREETCAR AND not driving on a one-way road.
rules.note: 10.40 says that most passing is done on the left. The same block permits passing on the right on multi-lane or one-way roads and when overtaking a STREETCAR or a left-turning vehicle (PASS-SIDE-01), and 10.41 adds that passing on the right can be more dangerous. The exception is the streetcar requirement of 10.44 (PASS-SIDE-03). The right shoulder may be used to pass a vehicle turning left (PASS-LOC-07); never the left shoulder (PASS-LOC-06). Where a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE, tow truck or roadside hazard is on the left, moving over a lane away from it (PASS-USER-20, PASS-USER-22) may mean passing it on the right; those rules apply. This rule says which side to pass on, not whether to pass.

rules.title: Cyclists: one metre
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when 1 metre is impractical

rules.note: Diagram 2-11 shows the 1 metre gap.

rules.title: No unnecessary horn when overtaking cyclists
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn unnecessarily
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST NOT sound the horn unnecessarily.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when the horn is necessary

rules.note: Reason given: it may frighten the cyclist and cause loss of control.

rules.title: Tap horn lightly and early
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST AND the DRIVER feels the horn must be used
rules.action: tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST AND the DRIVER feels the horn must be used, the DRIVER MUST tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given
no duration or loudness given

vague_terms.term: the DRIVER feels the horn must be used
vague_terms.explanation: left to the driver's judgement; no criteria given

rules.note: Reason given: sounding the horn may frighten the cyclist and cause loss of control.

rules.title: Pass two-wheelers by changing lanes
rules.when: a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped has pulled to the left or right side of its lane AND the DRIVER wants to pass it
rules.action: pass by changing lanes, not within the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped has pulled to the left or right side of its lane AND the DRIVER wants to pass it, the DRIVER MUST pass by changing lanes, not within the same lane.
rules.note: These riders often move to one side of their lane for road conditions or visibility; the handbook says this is not an invitation to pass in the same lane. Passing cyclists in general is PASS-USER-24; the one-metre gap is PASS-USER-01.

rules.title: Do not pull beside a smaller vehicle to turn left with it
rules.when: making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: pull up beside it to make the left turn at the same time
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the DRIVER MUST NOT pull up beside it to make the left turn at the same time.
rules.note: The handbook says stay behind and turn when the way is clear.

rules.title: Wait for a smaller vehicle to move right before passing
rules.when: the DRIVER has turned left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped (the smaller vehicle) and is still behind it
rules.action: pass the smaller vehicle
rules.unless: the smaller vehicle has moved right
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has turned left behind a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped (the smaller vehicle) and is still behind it, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass the smaller vehicle, UNLESS the smaller vehicle has moved right.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how far right

rules.note: In 9.18 this follows the instruction not to pull up beside the smaller vehicle and to stay behind it through the turn. The no-side-by-side turning instruction is PASS-USER-05.

rules.title: Do not cut in closely in front of a large vehicle
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: cut in closely in front of it
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST NOT cut in closely in front of it.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given

rules.note: Reason given: large vehicles need a much longer stopping distance (Diagram 2-16: about 90 m versus 60 m at 80 km/h).

rules.title: Allow more room when passing a large vehicle
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: allow more room in front of the LARGE VEHICLE than when passing a smaller vehicle, before returning to the original lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST allow more room in front of the LARGE VEHICLE than when passing a smaller vehicle, before returning to the original lane.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given

rules.note: The handbook says only 'Allow more room when passing a large vehicle'; that the room is in front of the vehicle before returning to the original lane, and more than for a smaller vehicle, is inferred from 6.55's sentences about not cutting in front closely and the longer stopping distance of large vehicles. The handbook also notes that turbulence from a large vehicle may affect control when passing it.

rules.title: Anticipate long commercial vehicles
rules.when: preparing to pass a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on the highway
rules.action: anticipate its extended length and limited speed
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to pass a LONG COMMERCIAL VEHICLE on the highway, the DRIVER SHOULD anticipate its extended length and limited speed.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed or speed limit for LCVs given
does not say what the driver should do differently

rules.title: Farm machinery: do not pass until safe
rules.when: behind farm machinery or another vehicle displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN
rules.action: pass
rules.unless: it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN behind farm machinery or another vehicle displaying a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass, UNLESS it is safe to do so.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria given

rules.note: The handbook also says to slow down, be cautious and stay well back; farm machinery may turn into fields or move between lanes.

rules.title: Horse-drawn vehicles: pass only when safe
rules.when: behind a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE
rules.action: pass
rules.unless: it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN behind a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass, UNLESS it is safe to do so.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria given

rules.title: Horse-drawn vehicles: give maximum distance
rules.when: passing a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE
rules.action: leave as much distance as possible between the PASSER's vehicle and the HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE
rules.statement: WHEN passing a HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST leave as much distance as possible between the PASSER's vehicle and the HORSE-DRAWN VEHICLE.

vague_terms.explanation: no minimum distance given

rules.note: Reason given: passing too closely could startle the horse and make it change direction suddenly.

rules.title: Never pass moving snow plows
rules.when: behind a moving SNOW PLOW
rules.action: pass it under any conditions
rules.statement: WHEN behind a moving SNOW PLOW, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass it under any conditions.

rules.title: Do not pass between staggered plows
rules.when: on a FREEWAY where several SNOW PLOWS are staggered across the road
rules.action: try to pass between them
rules.statement: WHEN on a FREEWAY where several SNOW PLOWS are staggered across the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT try to pass between them.
rules.note: Reason given: not enough room, and the ridge of wet snow can throw the vehicle out of control. Plows may have a wing extending up to 3 metres to the right.

rules.title: Watch for opening doors when passing parked vehicles
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the DRIVER MUST watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload.

vague_terms.explanation: no clearance from parked vehicles or speed reduction given

rules.title: Stay 2 metres behind streetcar doors
rules.when: at a STREETCAR stop where passengers are getting off or on
rules.action: stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors of the STREETCAR
rules.unless: an area has been set aside for STREETCAR passengers at the stop
rules.statement: WHEN at a STREETCAR stop where passengers are getting off or on, the DRIVER MUST stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors of the STREETCAR, UNLESS an area has been set aside for STREETCAR passengers at the stop.
rules.note: 10.45 words this as a plain command; Diagram 2-49 shows a vehicle stopped 'the required two metres' behind the rear doors. The stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: Pass streetcar passenger areas carefully
rules.when: passing a safety island or area set aside for STREETCAR passengers at a STREETCAR stop
rules.action: pass at a reasonable speed and be prepared for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves
rules.statement: WHEN passing a safety island or area set aside for STREETCAR passengers at a STREETCAR stop, the DRIVER MUST pass at a reasonable speed and be prepared for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed given

vague_terms.term: be prepared for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves
vague_terms.explanation: no specific action or margin given

rules.note: Stated on two pages (10.45, 6.18), both as plain commands. At stops with a safety island or passenger area, the requirement to stop two metres behind the streetcar's rear doors (PASS-USER-16) does not apply; this rule applies instead.

rules.title: Slow down for stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, an EMERGENCY VEHICLE stopped with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a tow truck stopped with its amber lights flashing
rules.action: reduce speed, assessing the speed of the surrounding traffic and the condition of the roadway, and proceed with caution
rules.statement: WHEN approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, an EMERGENCY VEHICLE stopped with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a tow truck stopped with its amber lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST reduce speed, assessing the speed of the surrounding traffic and the condition of the roadway, and proceed with caution.
rules.penalty: A fine and three demerit points for a first offence; higher fines and up to six months in jail for further offences.

vague_terms.explanation: amount or target speed not given
what caution requires is not stated

rules.note: Braking early and gradually is a separate rule (PASS-USER-19). Penalty: the three demerit points are listed for failing to slow and carefully pass a stopped emergency vehicle (22.129); the higher fines and jail term for further offences come from 13.117 (under 'Failing to respond to an emergency vehicle'), which 13.118 extends to a stopped tow truck.

rules.title: Brake early and gradually for a stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, an EMERGENCY VEHICLE stopped with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a tow truck stopped with its amber lights flashing
rules.action: brake early and gradually
rules.statement: WHEN approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, an EMERGENCY VEHICLE stopped with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a tow truck stopped with its amber lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST brake early and gradually.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or rate given

rules.note: Reason given: lets surrounding traffic adjust to the reduced speed and keeps the vehicle under full control.

rules.title: Move over for stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck
rules.when: the road has two or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction AND the DRIVER is approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, either an EMERGENCY VEHICLE stopped with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing or a tow truck stopped with its amber lights flashing
rules.action: move into a lane away from the EMERGENCY VEHICLE or tow truck, well in advance, signalling and checking mirrors and BLIND SPOTS
rules.unless: it is not safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN the road has two or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction AND the DRIVER is approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, either an EMERGENCY VEHICLE stopped with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing or a tow truck stopped with its amber lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST move into a lane away from the EMERGENCY VEHICLE or tow truck, well in advance, signalling and checking mirrors and BLIND SPOTS, UNLESS it is not safe to do so.
rules.penalty: A fine and three demerit points for a first offence; higher fines and up to six months in jail for further offences.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given

vague_terms.term: it is not safe to do so
vague_terms.explanation: does not say what makes moving over unsafe

rules.note: Diagram 2-57 shows a car moving over a lane away from a stopped ambulance. Penalty: the three demerit points are listed for failing to move, where possible, into another lane when passing a stopped emergency vehicle (22.130); the higher fines and jail term for further offences come from 13.117 (under 'Failing to respond to an emergency vehicle'), which 13.118 extends to a stopped tow truck. Moving over across a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane is unsafe in the handbook's terms (21.4, PASS-MARK-01), so the exception applies there, as for PASS-USER-22.

rules.title: Slow down to pass roadside workers
rules.when: approaching workers or vehicles on the road that pose a hazard, such as roadside assistance vehicles, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance workers or utility workers
rules.action: slow down and pass with caution
rules.statement: WHEN approaching workers or vehicles on the road that pose a hazard, such as roadside assistance vehicles, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance workers or utility workers, the DRIVER MUST slow down and pass with caution.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed or distance given
no amount or target speed given

rules.note: A stopped SCHOOL BUS with its overhead red lights flashing or its stop arm activated is covered by PASS-USER-25 (stop), not by this rule.

rules.title: Move over a lane for roadside workers and vehicles
rules.when: passing workers or vehicles on the road that pose a hazard, such as roadside assistance vehicles, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance workers or utility workers, AND it is safe to do so
rules.action: move over a lane to increase the space between the vehicle and the hazard
rules.statement: WHEN passing workers or vehicles on the road that pose a hazard, such as roadside assistance vehicles, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance workers or utility workers, AND it is safe to do so, the DRIVER MUST move over a lane to increase the space between the vehicle and the hazard.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria given

rules.note: The handbook says a SOLID LINE at the left of the lane means it is unsafe to pass (21.4, PASS-MARK-01) and gives no exception for passing a hazard. So where moving over a lane means crossing a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane, the condition 'it is safe to do so' is not met: the DRIVER stays in the lane, slowing down and passing with caution (PASS-USER-21). A stopped SCHOOL BUS with its overhead red lights flashing or its stop arm activated is covered by PASS-USER-25 (stop), not by this rule.

rules.title: Slow down and pass animals carefully
rules.when: an animal is on or near the road
rules.action: slow down and pass carefully
rules.statement: WHEN an animal is on or near the road, the DRIVER MUST slow down and pass carefully.

vague_terms.explanation: no amount or target speed given
no criteria given
no distance given

rules.note: Reason given: animals may suddenly bolt onto the road.

rules.title: Change lanes to pass cyclists
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST AND it is possible to change lanes
rules.action: change lanes to pass
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST AND it is possible to change lanes, the DRIVER SHOULD change lanes to pass.

vague_terms.term: it is possible to change lanes
vague_terms.explanation: does not say when a lane change is possible

rules.note: Diagram 2-47 shows a car moving into the next lane to pass a cyclist in a sharrow lane. When a rider has pulled to one side of the lane, PASS-USER-04 applies; the one-metre gap is PASS-USER-01.

rules.title: Stopped school bus: stop and do not proceed
rules.when: approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS that has its overhead red lights flashing or its stop arm activated AND the DRIVER is coming from behind the bus or the road has no MEDIAN STRIP
rules.action: stop, at least 20 metres away when coming from behind the bus or at a safe distance for children to get off the bus and cross the road when approaching from the front, and not proceed until the bus moves or the red lights have stopped flashing and the stop arm has folded away
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a stopped SCHOOL BUS that has its overhead red lights flashing or its stop arm activated AND the DRIVER is coming from behind the bus or the road has no MEDIAN STRIP, the DRIVER MUST stop, at least 20 metres away when coming from behind the bus or at a safe distance for children to get off the bus and cross the road when approaching from the front, and not proceed until the bus moves or the red lights have stopped flashing and the stop arm has folded away.
rules.penalty: A heavy fine and six demerit points for a first offence.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given

rules.note: On a road with a MEDIAN STRIP only vehicles coming from behind the bus must stop (8.29, 6.87). The rule applies on any road, however many lanes and whatever the speed limit (8.30), so the permissions to pass in PASS-SIDE-01 and PASS-MARK-02 do not apply. The release point is worded three ways: 'until the bus moves or the lights have stopped flashing' (8.26), 'until the arm folds away and all lights stop flashing' (8.31), and 'until the bus moves, the overhead red lights have stopped flashing and its stop arm is no longer activated' (6.89); the rule reads them together. 8.32 calls failing to stop having 'illegally passed a school bus'. Penalty: 8.32 and the six-point list (22.105); the registered owner may be given the fines but not the demerit points (8.32). Diagrams 2-27 and 2-28 show the stopping distance behind the bus on a two-way road and on a road with a median strip; Diagram 2-19 shows cars stopped 20 metres from a stopped bus. Signs 18.32 and 18.33 state the same duty; 18.33 is used on multi-lane highways with no centre median and binds drivers from both directions. A stopped SCHOOL BUS is covered by this rule, not by PASS-USER-21 or PASS-USER-22. School buses stopped at railway crossings do not use the red lights (8.33) and are not covered.

rules.title: No passing in fog
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: pass other vehicles
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass other vehicles.
rules.note: 14.19 words this as advice ('Avoid passing'); 14.35 says 'Don't pass other vehicles'. The stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: No speeding up to pass in fog
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: speed up to pass a vehicle moving slowly
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up to pass a vehicle moving slowly.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed or speed difference given

rules.note: Passing in fog at all is PASS-WX-01.

rules.title: No passing in blowing snow or whiteout
rules.when: driving in blowing snow OR a whiteout
rules.action: attempt to pass a vehicle moving slowly
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow OR a whiteout, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass a vehicle moving slowly.

vague_terms.explanation: no speed or speed difference given

rules.note: 14.68 also advises avoiding passing; the stronger 'Don't' of 14.76 is recorded.

rules.title: Move right and let faster traffic pass
rules.when: faster traffic wants to pass
rules.action: move to the right and let it pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to pass, the DRIVER being passed MUST move to the right and let it pass in safety.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say whether to change lanes or shift within the lane, or how far
does not say how the intent to pass is recognised
no criterion for a safe pass given

rules.note: 10.25 words this as a plain command; the sample test question (28.22, answer 28.26 per key 28.42) words it as 'you must … move to the right and allow such vehicle to pass'; the stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another DRIVER is trying to pass the DRIVER's vehicle
rules.action: speed up
rules.statement: WHEN another DRIVER is trying to pass the DRIVER's vehicle, the DRIVER being passed MUST NOT speed up.
rules.note: Stated as unlawful and dangerous in 10.20; sample test question 5 (28.22) marks 'speed up' (28.23) as a wrong answer per the answer key (28.42).

rules.title: Do not block a vehicle from passing
rules.when: another vehicle is passing or trying to pass the DRIVER's vehicle
rules.action: drive so as to prevent the other vehicle from passing
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing or trying to pass the DRIVER's vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive so as to prevent the other vehicle from passing.
rules.note: Listed among aggressive driving behaviours under sanctions for dangerous behaviours; the sample test also marks moving left to prevent passing as wrong (28.24).

rules.title: Being passed on an undivided road: keep right
rules.when: on an undivided road AND the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN on an undivided road AND the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER being passed MUST pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane.

vague_terms.term: move closer to the right side of the lane
vague_terms.explanation: no distance or lateral position given

rules.title: Be ready to slow to help the passer in
rules.when: on an undivided road AND the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: be prepared to slow down to let the PASSER get in front more quickly
rules.statement: WHEN on an undivided road AND the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER being passed MUST be prepared to slow down to let the PASSER get in front more quickly.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when slowing is needed or by how much

rules.note: Reason given: to prevent a collision.

rules.title: Clear the truck passing lane
rules.when: driving in the TRUCK PASSING LANE AND a truck wants to pass
rules.action: move into the lane to the right of the TRUCK PASSING LANE as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the TRUCK PASSING LANE AND a truck wants to pass, the DRIVER MUST move into the lane to the right of the TRUCK PASSING LANE as soon as possible.

vague_terms.explanation: no time or distance given
does not say how the truck's intent to pass is recognized

rules.note: Handbook wording is 'as soon as you can'. 'Move into the right-hand lane' (10.26) is read as the lane to the right of the TRUCK PASSING LANE.

rules.title: Cyclists may take the lane to discourage unsafe passing
rules.actor: CYCLIST or rider of a moped
rules.when: travelling slower than other traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely
rules.action: use any part of the lane to discourage passing
rules.statement: WHEN travelling slower than other traffic AND the lane is too narrow to be shared safely, the CYCLIST or rider of a moped MAY use any part of the lane to discourage passing.

vague_terms.term: too narrow to be shared safely
vague_terms.explanation: no lane width given

rules.note: Otherwise slower bicycles and mopeds are expected to ride about one metre from the curb or parked cars, or as close as practical to the right edge.

rules.title: Towing: enough time and room to pass
rules.when: about to pass another vehicle
rules.action: make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass another vehicle, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time given

rules.note: Reason given: a vehicle towing a trailer cannot accelerate as quickly and is much longer.

rules.title: Towing: do not cut back in too soon
rules.when: returning to the original lane after passing
rules.action: allow more room than when not towing before moving back and not cut back into the lane too soon
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after passing, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST allow more room than when not towing before moving back and not cut back into the lane too soon.

vague_terms.explanation: no distance given
no distance or time given

rules.note: Reason given: cutting back too soon can make the trailer sway and be hard to control.

rules.title: Towing: let a line of traffic pass
rules.when: holding up a line of traffic
rules.action: signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN holding up a line of traffic, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass.

vague_terms.term: holding up a line of traffic
vague_terms.explanation: no number of following vehicles or amount of delay given

rules.title: Towing: wind from a passing truck or bus
rules.when: a large bus or truck passes the DRIVER AND its wind pushes the trailer to the side
rules.action: carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position and not brake
rules.statement: WHEN a large bus or truck passes the DRIVER AND its wind pushes the trailer to the side, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position and not brake.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say how gently or gradually to steer

rules.note: The handbook adds that a slight increase in speed may help.
